title: Energy through a pulley system
caption: With 4 supporting ropes the effort moves 4 m for every 1 m the load rises (VR = 4). MA = 800 / 250 = 3.2, so efficiency = MA/VR = 80%: of 1000 J put in per metre of lift, 800 J raises the load.
alt: Energy flow diagram: 1000 joules of work in, 800 joules raising the load and 200 joules wasted.
description: Per metre the load rises: work in = 250 N × 4 m = 1000 J.
Wasted: 200 J, against friction and in lifting the lower pulley block.
